title: Boqortooyadii oo lagu tijaabiyay Webi
intro: Hoggaamiye ayaa ku kaca amar Ilaah waagii hore. Boqortooyada taliyahan kuma bilaaban ammaan laakiin waxay ku bilaabatay tijaabo biyo socda. Cadow xooggan ayaa la dagaallami lahaa ciidankooda, natiijaduna waxay dib u habayn doontaa taariikhda. Ma qiyaasi kartaa cidda uu yahay qofkani?
clues: Waxaa la ii doortay inaan hoggaamiyo qaran weyn, laakiin magacaabistu waxay ka timid xagga sare, ee ma ahayn mid ka timid dadka.
Shay xurmo leh ayaa loo soo celiyay dadkayga si ay u noqoto calaamad xaqiijinaysa xukunkayga.
Waxaan askarteyda ku tijaabiyay webi — badankood way ka cabbeen wayna ku guuldareysteen.
Dagaalyahan xoog badan oo la odhan jiray Jalut ayaa nagu soo duulay isagoo wata ciidan aad u badan.
Nin dhallinyaro ah oo aan isku koox nahay, oo aan wax iimaan ah haysan, ayaa Jalut ku dhuftay.
Ka dib guushii aan gaarnay, boqortooyada waxaa ugu dambeyntii loo dhiibay horyaalkii dhallinyarada ahaa.

trial.label: Tijaabo/Dhacdo
options: Waxaa la amray in la allabaryo wiil
Waxaa la amray in la dhiso doon weyn

outcome.label: Natiijo
options: Boqortooyada ayaa loo wareejiyay horyaalkii dhallinyarada ahaa (Dawud)
Si nabad ah ayaa looga soo saaray dab kulul
outcome.answer: Boqortooyada ayaa loo wareejiyay horyaalkii dhallinyarada ahaa (Dawud)

arabic: فَلَمَّا فَصَلَ طَالُوتُ بِٱلْجُنُودِ قَالَ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ مُبْتَلِيكُم بِنَهَرٍۢ فَمَن شَرِبَ مِنْهُ فَلَيْسَ مِنِّى وَمَن لَّمْ يَطْعَمْهُ فَإِنَّهُۥ مِنِّىٓ إِلَّا مَنِ ٱغْتَرَفَ غُرْفَةًۢ بِيَدِهِۦ ۚ فَشَرِبُوا۟ مِنْهُ إِلَّا قَلِيلًۭا مِّنْهُمْ ۚ فَلَمَّا جَاوَزَهُۥ هُوَ وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ مَعَهُۥ قَالُوا۟ لَا طَاقَةَ لَنَا ٱلْيَوْمَ بِجَالُوتَ وَجُنُودِهِۦ ۚ قَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ يَظُنُّونَ أَنَّهُم مُّلَـٰقُوا۟ ٱللَّهِ كَم مِّن فِئَةٍۢ قَلِيلَةٍ غَلَبَتْ فِئَةًۭ كَثِيرَةًۢ بِإِذْنِ ٱللَّهِ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ مَعَ ٱلصَّـٰبِرِينَ
verse: And when Saul went forth with the soldiers, he said, "Indeed, Allāh will be testing you with a river. So whoever drinks from it is not of me, and whoever does not taste it is indeed of me, excepting one who takes [from it] in the hollow of his hand." But they drank from it, except a [very] few of them. Then when he had crossed it along with those who believed with him, they said, "There is no power for us today against Goliath and his soldiers." But those who were certain that they would meet Allāh said, "How many a small company has overcome a large company by permission of Allāh. And Allāh is with the patient." (2:249)
